extract.one_liner: Voice AI Agents for Indian Languages

facts.claim: Provides conversational voice AI agents built for India, supporting over 10 vernacular Indian languages including Hinglish, Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu.
Used by Awign, Hyreo, GoKwik, Hypothesis, and Futwork.
Offers pay-as-you-go credit top-ups, a Pilot plan with fixed volume-based per-minute pricing, and custom Enterprise plans.
Provides 100% data privacy with India/USA specific data residency and on-prem deployment options.

pains.text: As a CTO/VP Eng at Bolna AI building multilingual voice agents for inbound and outbound calls (E8), the lack of a public security or trust center (E3, E4) means audit prep eats engineering hours because engineers must manually compile cloud, GitHub, and identity access evidence to prove compliance with data privacy mandates for India and the USA (E11) to prospective enterprise buyers.

For a seed-stage voice AI company with an early-stage headcount (E13) handling sensitive data residency requirements across India and the USA (E11), engineering teams lose critical development cycles on continuous evidence gathering across cloud resources, code repositories, and IAM providers instead of scaling their voice AI infrastructure.
